responsibility: Declares private, non-stable libgdiagnostics entry points used by the sarif-replay tooling rather than the public diagnostics library API. In addition to including the public C interface, it exposes extra ABI-versioned functions for attaching JSON property bags to diagnostic graphs, nodes, and edges, adding execution-path events with explicit physical/logical locations and state graphs, and setting a diagnostic’s nesting level, extending structured-diagnostic and SARIF-oriented construction beyond what libgdiagnostics.h publishes.
